Class GuiView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.View<GuiScreen>
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.gui.GuiView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ErrorReporter, ModelObserver
public class GuiView extends View<GuiScreen>
JavaFX GUI implementation of the View for the Galaxy Truckers game. This class manages the graphical user interface, handling screen transitions and user interaction through a JavaFX application.
